decisions.decision: Katey Adams will consult with Town Manager Lemieux on scheduling the Monty Tech meetings; Lemieux will contact Adams once the date and time are set.
decisions.quote: ms. adams will consult with ms. lemieux on the schedule for meeting with monty tech for this project.

decisions.decision: Mr. Alonzo asked that the by-law review committee be advertised for interested parties; the committee would make recommendations to the 2022 Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo asked for it to be advertised for interested parties.

decisions.decision: Chair directed that Town Counsel's opinion be obtained on possession of firearms on public land, with counsel to attend a future meeting when the topic is discussed.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo stated we need to get an opinion from town counsel regarding possession of a firearm on public land and that counsel should be present at a future meeting when this is discussed.

decisions.decision: Town Manager will pass the Conservation Commission and Open Space Committee information along to the pertinent chairmen.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will pass along the information to the pertinent chairmen.

decisions.decision: Chair asked board members to submit suggestions for an appointments procedure to him so he can compile them for a future discussion.
decisions.quote: he reminded the board to submit their suggestions for a procedure to him so he can compile them for a future discussion.

decisions.decision: Town Manager will ask the Assistant Town Manager to proceed with a Request for Proposals for the Brooks House, unless the Board objects; no objection is recorded.
decisions.quote: i will be asking the assistant town manager to proceed with putting together a request for proposals to carry this out, unless the board has an objection to this.
